ruleDefinitions.name: Add SafeBoot Keys Via Reg Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "add" or "copy" flags on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to allow the ransomware to work in safe mode as some security products do not

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ copy\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*")))
